generationInputs.prompt: A neon orange illustration on a black background depicts a transformed image related to the seventh card of the tarot. The image shows a figure in a chariot pulled by two sphinx-like creatures. The chariot has a visible wheel on the right side, a rounded body, and a tall, slender pole extending upwards. The figure in the chariot appears to be an adult male with a helmet that covers most of his head, leaving only a portion of his face visible. He has visible arms and hands holding reins that connect to the two creatures in front. The creatures resemble lions with human-like faces, wearing decorative headpieces and collars. They are positioned side-by-side, facing forward. Above the chariot, thirteen neon orange dots are arranged with lines radiating downwards from each dot towards the chariot and the figures. The overall style is reminiscent of neon sign art with sharp, glowing lines.
